dimensions.name: Autonomous orchestration
dimensions.blocker: Research, recommendation and founder-decision flows now run broadly under bounded policy, but SelfOperate still has not completed an unattended live journey across premium website production, payment and outbound/provider writes. Several execution adapters remain deployment-disabled, and the integrated Stromation website proof is still paused before the production/full-build handoff.

dimensions.name: Premium website-generation capability
dimensions.blocker: The signed, budget-bounded SelfOperate-to-Stromation capability is integrated, but the real website proof remains paused and unpublished before the production/full-build handoff. There is still no repeatable unattended premium completion, and no newer shipping-quality evidence has displaced the directly relevant PR #198 recovery state.

dimensions.name: Customer acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: The acquisition surface is now instrumented and materially more complete, but there is still no demonstrated repeatable real-traffic to checkout to paid-customer loop. Live Stripe remains intentionally disabled while the Texas sales-and-use-tax registration is pending, so conversion and CAC cannot yet be measured end to end.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: There is still no verified paying SelfOperate/Business Builder cohort, recurring revenue, CAC, gross margin, retention or paid-delivery economics. Stronger onboarding, recommendation and operating-product capability do not substitute for external economic proof.

changed: The biggest change is that SelfOperate's pre-purchase and acquisition layer moved from a good product shell into a deployed research-first decision system. The live path now starts from one open question, interprets the founder's journey, measures the funnel first-party, opens bounded research to signed-in founders, reports research progress, offers evidence-grounded directions, product/channel/economics plans, three rendered brand directions, a blueprint/value gap, an operating preview, an existing-business public footprint and a returning-founder state. Those changes are deployed through revision :121 and the recommendation review now runs end to end in CI. That materially raises fulfillment, agent capability, commercial readiness and acquisition readiness. The counterweight is unchanged at the execution edge: live Stripe and outbound delivery remain disabled, several provider-write adapters remain gated, and the integrated Stromation website proof is still paused before full production build, so autonomy and website-generation confidence do not move higher today.
method: Business Builder/SelfOperate-only independent forecast grounded in the 2026-09-23 canonical dariusstrongman/businessbuilder main, live selfoperate.com revision :121 at product commit 21943c0, repeated existing-business pilot acceptance, deployed onboarding/research/recommendation work through PRs #89-#109, current Stripe/tax-registration and provider-enablements, and only directly relevant Stromation website capability/recovery evidence through PR #198 plus prior Phase 6-6.6 quality evidence. Merged implementation is distinguished from deployed/live proof, and external provider/legal gates are not treated as completed engineering. Unrelated Stromation ventures, company-wide autonomy and Stromation customer/revenue status are excluded. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
